article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Redd Thompson had 27 points, including the go-ahead free throws with 19 seconds left, in Mount St. Mary’s 75-74 win over Morgan State on Tuesday night. Thompson added five assists for the Mountaineers (2-4). Wilguens Exacte Jr. scored 16 points and added eight rebounds. Abdou Khadre Kebe had seven points and went 3 of 10 from the field (0 for 5 from 3-point range). David Bumpass finished with 18 points and four assists for the Bears (4-4). Morgan State also got 13 points from Alfred Worrell Jr. Keith Richards finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
